review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery capability for transient database connection drops when using Neon's walsender, which surfaces failures as psycopg.errors.InternalError_ rather than the standard OperationalError.
review.reason: Adds psycopg.errors.InternalError_ to exception handling and a corresponding test, expanding recovery behavior for a specific database compatibility edge case.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual production recovery or complete implementation context.
